visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Enum Instead of int Constants
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Colours are int constants and describe() has a default branch for numbers that are not colours. Use an enum so only real colours can be passed. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: With int constants describe(7) compiles and returns "unknown". An enum parameter can only be one of the three colours, and a typo in a constant name is a compile error.
